title: Japan GSI Disaster-Response Aerial Imagery (COGs)
description: Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFFs reassembled from GSI's disaster-response aerial imagery (正射画像 / 正射画像速報) — emergency orthophotos GSI publishes during and after a disaster response, before folding them into regular map products. One COG per GSI layer; grows over time as new disasters are processed. Generated by the open-source optgeo/cogenerate pipeline.
